actual_root_cause: SSL_R_BAD_SIGNATURE was defined as 148 (SSL_R_DH_PUBLIC_VALUE_LENGTH_IS_WRONG) instead of 123; that alone produced the S33 error string.
tls12_verify did not implement rsa_pss_rsae/pss (0x0804-0x0806, 0x0809-0x080b) or DSA (0x0402/0x0502/0x0602) schemes, so an authority server's PSS signature failed verification.
tls12_process_server_key_exchange had no SSL_kDHE arm at all: a DHE ServerKeyExchange was rejected before any parameter could be read.

The client advertised extended_master_secret but neither recorded the server's echo nor derived RFC 7627's session-hash master secret, so even a correctly parsed exchange would have diverged at Finished.
The reduced TLS1.2 cipher map did not know the DHE GCM suites (0x009e/0x009f/0x00a2/0x00a3).

why: The authority completes the same TLS1.2 DHE handshake, so refusing SSL_kDHE would preserve a known parity break.

The crate already owns every primitive the authority's tls_process_ske_dhe/tls_construct_cke_dhe sequence needs: provider DH import (EVP_PKEY_fromdata), template keygen, EVP_PKEY_param_check_quick/public_check, EVP_PKEY_derive and DH_compute_key.
perl-net-ssleay and any consumer that offers only DHE suites would remain blocked; narrowing the predicate only hides the defect.
implementation_shape: Parse p/g/Ys with SliceCursor's checked lengths; on a short vector raise SSL_AD_DECODE_ERROR / SSL_R_LENGTH_MISMATCH.

Import the peer with BN_bin2bn + OSSL_PARAM_BLD_push_BN (the authority's path), then EVP_PKEY_fromdata with EVP_PKEY_KEYPAIR. This is load-bearing: OSSL_PARAM_construct_BN treats its buffer as native-endian, so feeding the big-endian wire vectors directly silently produced a different DH public key (found and corrected during this subphase).

Run EVP_PKEY_param_check_quick then EVP_PKEY_public_check; failure is SSL_AD_ILLEGAL_PARAMETER / SSL_R_BAD_DH_VALUE. Then ssl_security(SSL_SECOP_TMP_DH, EVP_PKEY_get_security_bits) -> SSL_AD_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE / SSL_R_DH_KEY_TOO_SMALL.

Verify the ServerKeyExchange signature over client_random || server_random || params with the shared tls12_verify, retaining the RSA and DSA arms and adding the PSS/ DSA schemes; failure is SSL_AD_DECRYPT_ERROR / SSL_R_BAD_SIGNATURE (now 123).

Construct ClientDHParams: keygen from the peer template, derive the premaster through tls13_derive_shared, and send dh_Yc padded to the prime length. The DHE premaster is heap-allocated in a cleansing owner (up to 1250 bytes at the 10000-bit ceiling), not the 80-byte ECDHE/RSA scratch.

Write the ClientKeyExchange before deriving the master secret, matching tls_construct_client_key_exchange -> tls_client_key_exchange_post_work; record the ServerHello extended_master_secret echo and derive RFC 7627's session-hash master secret when set.
